canonical_project: GreenLine Technologies / SOCATEL Tier III Data Center
owner: GreenLine Technologies Inc. / SOCATEL / Government of Central African Republic
notes: GreenLine's official September 2025 announcement says its SOCATEL mandate includes a new Tier 3 data center and modern connectivity ecosystem backed by an initial $150 million investment. Journal de Bangui reported that on July 16, 2026 authorities launched the operational phase in Bangui, including a Tier III data center; La Tribune / Agence Ecofin reported the same project at EUR 131.5 million. Site-level MW capacity and exact address were not disclosed.
